No, Leafy Plus does not include free Express shipping. Express is always $14.95, including for Leafy Plus members.

What Leafy Plus does include for shipping is free Standard shipping with no minimum order. Standard delivery takes 2–3 business days in Zone 1, 3–5 in Zone 2, and 5–8 in Zone 3. Express is available in Zones 1 and 2 only (next business day and 2 business days respectively), and isn't available in Zone 3.

One more thing: XL plants (usually over 4 ft) add a $20 handling fee and ship Standard only, so that fee still applies to them.
